_meta.purpose: Central registry of vetted sources for the field guide, reusable across cities.
_meta.howToUse: Run `node tools/research.js "<City>" "<ST>"` to get the search plan for a new city, run those searches, rank what you find, fact-check, then record the winners here before building a page. See docs/SOURCES.md.
_meta.rankScale: 1 = primary (transcribe fully); 2 = strong corroboration; 3 = supplemental / leads only.
_meta.verified: true only if a claim from the source was checked via web search during this build.

sourceTypes.label: Local TV station numbered list
sourceTypes.why: Reported, photographed, numbered — ideal to transcribe and verify against.
sourceTypes.find: search '100 hidden gems of {city}', '{n} best {city} ...'; identify the metro's ABC/CBS/NBC/FOX affiliates first.

sourceTypes.label: Atlas Obscura city/state index
sourceTypes.why: The oddities backbone. Read the index, not individual searches.

sourceTypes.label: Roadside America state index
sourceTypes.why: Second oddity net; catches what Atlas Obscura misses.

sourceTypes.label: Alt-weekly
sourceTypes.why: Best food and nightlife coverage in most metros.
sourceTypes.find: search '{city} alt weekly' (e.g. Scene, Reader, Weekly).

sourceTypes.label: City / regional magazine
sourceTypes.why: Strong on neighbourhood dining and features.

sourceTypes.label: Regional business / daily news
sourceTypes.find: search '{city} business journal' / the metro daily.

sourceTypes.label: Nonprofit local newsroom
sourceTypes.why: Civic, specific, often the best replacement for a shuttered daily.
sourceTypes.find: search '{city} nonprofit news' (e.g. Matters, Signal, Documenters).

sourceTypes.label: Historical society / public history project
sourceTypes.find: search '{city} historical society' and university public-history projects.

sourceTypes.label: Metro / regional parks authority
sourceTypes.why: Authoritative on parks, trails, natural landmarks.

sourceTypes.label: Local CVB / visitors bureau
sourceTypes.why: The city's own curated list, usually current.

sourceTypes.label: Famous travel YouTuber / blogger coverage
sourceTypes.why: Popular, watchable corroboration; signals what draws outsiders. Rank by whether they actually covered THIS city vs. the region.
sourceTypes.find: search 'famous travel YouTuber visited {city} {state}', '{creator} {city}', '{city} walking tour youtube'.

sourceTypes.label: Local creator / walking-tour channel
sourceTypes.why: Ground-level, current footage of specific streets and sites.
sourceTypes.find: search '{city} walking tour youtube', '{city} things to do youtube channel'.

sourceTypes.label: Independent travel blog round-up
sourceTypes.why: Cross-checks the mainstream list; use to corroborate, not as the spine.
sourceTypes.find: search 'best things to do in {city} {state} travel blog {year}'.
